versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No other functional or documentation changes in this release.

- Added a license field (MIT) to the skill metadata.
- Expanded documentation to explain how to look up generated methods, types, and parameters using go doc and pkg.go.dev.
- Clarified method naming conventions and parameter use from OpenAPI operation IDs.
- Removed the separate skill-card.md file.

go-bunnynet 0.1.0 initial release

- Introduces an unofficial Go client for the Bunny.net core API (github.com/psyb0t/go-bunnynet).
- Supports operations for CDN, DNS, storage, video library, load balancers, statistics, and billing.
- Excludes storage file transfers and the separate Stream API.
- Requires the BUNNYNET_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
- Guides safe usage: handle credentials securely and use with care for account-altering operations.
- Includes instructions for installing, configuring, and handling API responses in Go projects.
